verses.2: Let his voice be weighed as if it were a precious gem; let its sound be heard together in my ears.
verses.3: Now, as the waters submerge everything, so too will my words be forgotten.
verses.4: For those who stand by the sides of Shadya, whose heat has consumed my spirit in the midst of the Lord’s anger, they will surely destroy me.
verses.5: May it be that the tree is struck by lightning, if the branch gets damaged on its leaves.
verses.6: It can be eaten without salt, if it has a strange, unpleasant taste.
verses.7: May my soul be freed from all these burdens, just like butter is freed from its lumps.
verses.8: Who will give me the victory? My prayers and pleas will be heard by the Lord.
verses.9: And the Lord will come and touch me with His hand, and He will guide me.
verses.10: And my love still remained with me. It was strong and unyielding; it wouldn’t yield, because I had spoken the words of the Lord.
verses.11: What strength do I have when I am alone? And what limit does my soul have when I am free?
verses.12: Whether it’s the strength of stones, or whether it’s in my words that I am strong.
verses.13: Is there no help for me, and is my hope rejected from me?
verses.14: May the Lord have mercy on him, and may the fear of the Lord be upon him.
verses.15: My brothers, let them be like streams that flow along.
verses.16: The frost from Mini-Karach will make it snow.
verses.17: At the time of their destruction, they were destroyed in their own place.
verses.18: Their steps will be blocked, and they will be led astray.
verses.19: Look at the ruins of Teman, where the people once lived.
verses.20: They surely came to her, and they began to plow the land.
verses.21: For now, you will see his appearance and be afraid.
verses.22: For I said, “Let them be destroyed,” and because of your actions, they were destroyed in my place.
verses.23: And they will save me from the hands of the wicked and from the hands of those who are cruel.
verses.24: Horeuni and I are brothers. They understood what I meant.
verses.25: What will be the fate of the words of wisdom? And what will be the punishment for those who speak them?
verses.26: Let them forget the words, and let their thoughts be lost in oblivion.
verses.27: They shall fall upon their faces, and be ashamed before their enemies.
verses.28: And now, if they turn against me and against you…
verses.29: Please do not be wicked again. Come back and be just once more.
verses.30: There might be differences in interpretation; if I wait, I won’t understand them.
